title: A change-management MCP server for Lighthouse
scenario: A one-tool-per-endpoint wrapper over the change system confused the model, flooded its context and once filed a change on behalf of someone named in a comment. Build the replacement: an MCP server with four task-shaped tools over a change store and a CMDB, identity from the verified token only, tested in-process with the MCP Python SDK.
task: Four task-shaped tools with typed, validated inputs
Identity bound from the verified token; no identity arguments
acceptance: Schema, validation, permission and pagination tests pass
ANSWER.md maps five tool-design rules to code and describes deployment
